questions.problem:
Find the value of ${x}_{1}-{x}_{2}$ given that  $4a+3x=b$ and

$$
a=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}18 \\ -15 \\ -9\end{aligned}].
$$
questions.worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}4a+3x & =b \\ 3x & =b-4a \\ x & =\frac{1}{3}(b-4a) \\ x & =\frac{1}{3}([\begin{aligned}18 \\ -15 \\ -9\end{aligned}]-4[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3 \\ 3\end{aligned}]) \\ x & =\frac{1}{3}[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -27 \\ -21\end{aligned}] \\ x & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -9 \\ -7\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=2-(-9)=11.$

questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-11 \\ 8 \\ -14\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-11 \\ 8 \\ -14\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1} \\ 4{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-11 \\ 8 \\ -14\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-11 \\ 8 \\ -14\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}=-11 \\ 4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=8 \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=-14\end{aligned}
$$

Adding the second and the third equations we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}6{x}_{1} & =-6 \\ {x}_{1} & =-1,\end{aligned}
$$

which we substitute into the second equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} & =8 \\ 4(-1)+3{x}_{2} & =8 \\ 3{x}_{2} & =12 \\ {x}_{2} & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-1$ and ${x}_{2}=4$ into the first equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} & =-11 \\ 3(-1)-2(4) & =-11 \\ -11 & =-11,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-1$ and ${x}_{2}=4,$ which means

$$
-{a}_{1}+4{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-1+4=3.
$$

questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then   we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -{x}_{3} \\ -3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-2 \\ -{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=5 \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & 5 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=(-1){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -5 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -12\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-2 \\ {x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-5 \\ 0=-12.\end{aligned}
$$

However, the final equation $0=-12$  gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.

questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -11 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -18 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -11 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -18 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{3} \\ -11{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -18 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3} \\ -2{x}_{2}-11{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -18 \\ -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=5 \\ -2{x}_{2}-11{x}_{3}=-18 \\ {x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & 5 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -18 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & 5 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -18 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & 5 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -18 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -18\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & -15 & -30\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=-\frac{1}{15}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=5 \\ {x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-6 \\ {x}_{3}=2.\end{aligned}
$$

 

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=2.$ Substituting this value into  the second equation, we get

$$
{x}_{2}-2(2)=-6\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=-2.
$$

 

Finally, by substituting ${x}_{2}=-2$ and ${x}_{3}=2$ into the first equation, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3} & =5 \\ {x}_{1}+(-2)+3(2) & =5 \\ {x}_{1}+4 & =5 \\ {x}_{1} & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=1$, ${x}_{2}=-2$, and ${x}_{3}=2,$ which means 

$$
{a}_{1}-2{a}_{2}+2{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1+(-2)+2=1.
$$

questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ -2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-3 \\ -2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=1 \\ 3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-4\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $2$ and adding the resulting equations, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & =-5,\end{aligned}
$$

which we substitute into the second equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=1 \\ -2{x}_{1}-3(-5) & =1 \\ -2{x}_{1} & =-14 \\ {x}_{1} & =7.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=7$ and ${x}_{2}=-5$ into the third equation and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-4 \\ 3(7)+5(-5) & =-4 \\ -4 & =-4,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=7$ and ${x}_{2}=-5,$ which means

$$
7{a}_{1}-5{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=7+(-5)=2.
$$
